core_metaphor.concept: A constantly flowing river of data from which a single, random drop is selected.
core_metaphor.why: This metaphor visualizes the continuous stream of comments and the challenge of selecting a single, equally likely winner from an unknown total. The 'river' represents the infinite stream, and a 'drop' represents a comment. The randomness is inherent in nature, and the challenge is to 'catch' the right drop.

narrative_beats.summary: Introduce the challenge of building a giveaway system for a live stream with millions of non-stop comments, requiring a single random winner without knowing the total number of comments or when the stream will end, and without storing all comments due to memory limitations.
narrative_beats.key_visual: A torrent of data/comments flowing rapidly into a small, overflowing container with a 'memory full' warning.

narrative_beats.summary: Introduce Reservoir Sampling as the elegant mathematical solution that uses only one variable of memory to ensure every comment has an equal chance of winning.
narrative_beats.key_visual: The overflowing container is replaced by a single, stable 'holding area' that can contain one winner. A visual representation of a 'die roll' or probability calculation appears.

narrative_beats.summary: Explain the core mechanic: always hold one winner, and when the nth comment arrives, replace the current winner with a 1/n chance. This ensures mathematical fairness for all comments.
narrative_beats.key_visual: A visual depiction of the 'one variable' holding a winner. As new comments (drops) arrive, a 'chance' mechanism (e.g., a spinning wheel or dice) decides if the current winner is replaced by the new comment.

narrative_beats.summary: Pose a new challenge: how to modify the algorithm to pick exactly five winners without storing the rest, pushing the viewer to think critically about the solution.
narrative_beats.key_visual: The 'one winner' holding area expands to show space for five winners, with question marks indicating the complexity of adapting the 1/n probability for multiple selections.

narrative_beats.summary: The speaker identifies themselves and their role, encouraging viewers to follow for more engineering insights and share with others interested in technical puzzles.
narrative_beats.key_visual: Speaker's profile picture/logo with professional title. A call-to-action graphic encouraging follows and shares.

visual_elements: A single 'memory' variable (e.g., a small box or holder)
Probability/randomness indicator (e.g., dice, spinning wheel, probability scale)
Winner display area (initially one, then expanding to five)
